hooks.code: async (input) => { const s = String(await tools.mcp__plugin_browser_playwright__browser_tabs({ action: "list" })); const ix = [...s.matchAll(/^\s*-\s*(\d+):/gm)].map(m => +m[1]); if (ix.length < 2) return "no task tabs"; for (const i of ix.slice(1).reverse()) await tools.mcp__plugin_browser_playwright__browser_tabs({ action: "close", index: i }); return "closed " + (ix.length - 1) + " task tab(s), base tab kept"; }
